name: ERA5
description: The fifth generation ECMWF atmospheric reanalysis, providing a global, hourly estimate of atmospheric, land and ocean-wave variables from 1940 onward. ERA5 is accessed through the Copernicus Climate Data Store (CDS); users must configure CDS credentials and accept the applicable dataset terms. This record describes the dataset and loader access, and does not distribute data.
citation: Hersbach, H., et al. (2020). The ERA5 global reanalysis. Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society, 146(730), 1999–2049. https://doi.org/10.1002/qj.3803
